figurative_meaning_en: Discrepancy or confusion in verbal or quick accounting
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার হিসাবে শুভঙ্করের ফাঁক পড়েছে, কোনো কিছু মিলছে না।
দোকানের মালিকের সাথে কথা বলে বুঝলাম, এতে শুভঙ্করের ফাঁক আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: There's a Shubhankar's gap in his accounts; nothing adds up.
After talking to the shopkeeper, I realized there was a discrepancy in the verbal calculation.
note: This idiom likely originates from traditional Bengali trading practices where quick mental calculations often led to errors.
